_comment: Private signing key for the seeded key-enrolled kiosk session TestAKiosk02 in synthetic.json, whose public_key/key_fingerprint are the matching public half. NOT A SECRET: a throwaway P-256 keypair that authenticates nothing beyond a local database, committed so kiosk testing needs no enrolment step. Base64 DER (PKCS8/SPKI) because that is what WebCrypto importKey takes. Installed into the browser by local/examples/kiosk-scan.mjs; if you regenerate it, update both files.
